notes: BUU v3.0.3 - worker pool rebuild. Auto-scaling now works and is contained: live workers can never exceed your Max again (a Max of 4 once became 29 - fixed, with a test that proves the guard). Scaling decides on OVERALL rows/min, never per-row time. New sidebar: Max is a hard lid (lower it mid-run and workers drain), Start is the initial count only (default 9, not a floor), Hardware + PestPac sliders 1-5 (4 = regular 100%), eval-every is a box again, one-click Reset defaults. Each flow remembers its best measured worker count and starts there next run. License counting is ALWAYS on - unticking Auto-scale no longer disables seat counting or the buffer, and scheduled runs now count seats too. Also: journal records which worker did each row, in-app updates install correctly again, and the right-shift layout bug is fixed.
